text:
Jamal: Cutting a micro RC now for feature/micro-batch. Tagging as canary-rc-1763. Need quick QA + release owner ack, holding a 30m quiet window — please ack if you see anything.
deploy-bot: Candidate created: canary-rc-1763 | artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/serve:sha256:abcd1234 | pinned=true | use: `/deploy promote canary-rc-1763 --to=canary` to start canary.
Sylvia: Ack — starting smoke suite against canary-rc-1763 (smoke + perf light). ETA ~12m.
Jamal: Notes for canary: route initial 10% traffic. KV warm job scheduled. Abort conditions: p50 latency > 120ms OR error rate > 0.5% sustained 3m.
Ria: Please paste smoke results here. Also include explicit rollback command in release notes before we lift.
deploy-bot: Command queued: `/deploy start canary-rc-1763 --traffic=10% --kv-warm=true`
Sylvia: smoke: PASS. Ran 50 sample queries, no errors, memory usage stable. sample logs: `200 OK` from model pods. :thumbsup:
Patrick: Infra check: mounts + PVC ready, nodes healthy. Observability checks green. :eyes: dashboards -> https://dashboards.internal/redwood/rc/1763
Jamal: If smoke holds, we will ramp to 30% over 10m. Rollback payload (copy to release notes):
```bash
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy rollback promo-1763001 --to=stable
# unpin candidate
/gcr unpin gcr.io/redwood/serve:sha256:abcd1234
```
OncallBot: Mute policy applied for 15m during staged lift per ops policy. Alerts will still fire but will be marked as noisy.
Ria: I'm giving conditional signoff: Ria (release manager) approves promotion to staged prod after 30m stable at 30% and no signal regressions. Jamal, proceed if you see green.
Jamal: Kicking ramp to 30% (10m stair). Promotion command:
`/deploy promote canary-rc-1763 --to=prod --staged "30%:10m" --tag "micro-batch-kv-warm"`
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Promotion ID: promo-1763001. Expected ramp finish ~1763003034. Check status: `/deploy status promo-1763001`.
Patrick: Watching telemetry, will hit pause if any alert. Good luck :rocket:
Sylvia: Noted, monitoring logs and latency. Will post final thumbs once 30m stable.
Jamal: Thanks team — will assemble release_notes: "micro-batch perf tweak; KV warm prefetch; canary observed no regressions." Will publish once promo completes.
deploy-bot: Promo progress: 10% -> 30% in progress. Next update in ~5m.
Sylvia: 30m status: stable, no regressions seen from smoke probes. :white_check_mark:
Ria: Final signoff from RM, proceed to full lift at next window. Closing quiet window"
